# Nault Law — The Law Office of Stephen Nault

> Tennessee business and real estate law firm based in Gallatin, TN. Stephen C. Nault, Esq. provides counsel on commercial leasing, business formation and contracts, owner and partner disputes, real estate transactions and disputes, TREC/brokerage matters, and dispute resolution. Statewide advisory work; trial representation across Middle Tennessee.

Stephen C. Nault (Stephen, not Steven), Esq. is a Tennessee attorney (TN BPR #036562) licensed since 2012 and also a licensed Tennessee real estate broker. He is a Tennessee Supreme Court Rule 31 Listed General Civil Mediator, a real estate expert witness, and a TREC continuing-education course instructor. His background began in commercial real estate — financial analysis, property management, and his own real estate investment company — before he turned to law, which is the basis for the firm's industry-informed approach.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Attorney: Stephen C. Nault, Esq. — TN BPR #036562, licensed in Tennessee since 2012
- Firm: The Law Office of Stephen Nault (Nault Law)
- Office: 121 S. Hickory Ave, Gallatin, TN 37066
- Phone: (615) 953-9505
- Service area: statewide advisory work; trial representation in Sumner, Wilson, Robertson, Trousdale, Williamson, and Davidson Counties
- Credentials: Tennessee attorney; Tennessee licensed real estate broker; Rule 31 Listed Mediator; real estate expert witness; TREC course instructor
- Matters are handled directly by Stephen Nault, not delegated to associates
- Note: this is a business and real estate practice. The firm does NOT handle residential real estate closings (it is not a closing attorney), criminal, family, personal injury, bankruptcy, or immigration matters.

## Practice Areas (overview hubs)

- [Practice Areas overview](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas): Eight areas across business law, real estate, dispute resolution, and attorney support.
- [Commercial Leasing](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/commercial-leasing): LOI review, lease defaults, CAM reconciliations, and exit strategy for commercial tenants and landlords.
- [TREC Defense and Realtor Representation](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/trec-defense-and-realtor-complaints): Representing real estate professionals and their clients in complaints, investigations, and pre-complaint review.
- [Business Owner & Partner Disputes](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/operating-agreements-and-owner-disputes): Deadlock, distribution disputes, fiduciary concerns, and forced-buyout demands.
- [Business Contracts](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/business-contract-drafting-and-review): Contracts drafted, reviewed before signing, enforced, or defended against breach claims.
- [Real Estate Disputes](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/real-estate-disputes): Failed transactions, title problems, earnest money disputes, and broker conduct issues.
- [Strategic Case Assessment](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/strategic-case-assessment): A structured, honest review of a situation before committing to a lawsuit.
- [Arbitration, Mediation and ADR](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/arbitration-and-dispute-resolution): Forum selection, demand strategy, arbitration positioning, and settlement leverage.
- [Real Estate Expert Witness](https://naultlaw.com/practice-areas/expert-witness-real-estate-and-brokerage-matters): Industry-informed analysis where professional standards, custom, and practice are at issue.

## Focused-Issue Service Pages

- [All focused service pages](https://naultlaw.com/services): Six hubs organized by specific matter type.
- [Real Estate Expert Witness in Tennessee](https://naultlaw.com/services/expert-witness): Title, contract, valuation, and standard-of-care disputes; CV and prior testimony available.
- [Business Formation Attorney in Tennessee](https://naultlaw.com/services/business-formation): LLCs, PLLCs, S-Corp elections, operating agreements, and buy-sell agreements.
- [Business Contract Attorney in Tennessee](https://naultlaw.com/services/contract-services): Vendor, independent-contractor, lease, real-estate, and construction agreements; flat-fee review.
- [Real Estate Transactions Attorney in Tennessee](https://naultlaw.com/services/real-estate-transactions): Purchase agreements, commercial leases, owner financing, and joint ventures.
- [Real Estate Disputes Attorney in Tennessee](https://naultlaw.com/services/real-estate-disputes): Quiet title, easements, mechanics liens, fraud, and disclosure claims.
- [Business Disputes Attorney in Tennessee](https://naultlaw.com/services/business-disputes): Partnership breakups, member buyouts, non-competes, and fiduciary-duty claims.

## Articles (practical guides)

- [When a Broker Complaint Turns Into a Records Problem](https://naultlaw.com/articles/when-a-broker-complaint-turns-into-a-records-problem): How Tennessee broker complaints become fights over the transaction file.
- [Commission Disputes That Carry More Than Money Risk](https://naultlaw.com/articles/commission-disputes-that-carry-more-than-money-risk): When a commission fight sits inside a larger agency and disclosure problem.
- [When a Transaction Complaint May Also Create Civil Exposure](https://naultlaw.com/articles/when-a-transaction-complaint-may-also-create-civil-exposure): How one set of facts can open both a regulatory complaint and a civil claim.
- [Deadlock in a Closely Held Business](https://naultlaw.com/articles/deadlock-in-a-closely-held-business-decision-points-before-escalation): Decision points before an LLC deadlock escalates.
- [When the Operating Agreement No Longer Matches Reality](https://naultlaw.com/articles/when-the-operating-agreement-no-longer-matches-reality): When the agreement says one thing and the business has drifted into another.
- [Books, Records, and Account Access: Early Control Red Flags](https://naultlaw.com/articles/books-records-and-account-access-early-control-red-flags): Loss of access to company books as an early control problem.
- [Early Mistakes That Make a Brokerage Complaint Worse](https://naultlaw.com/articles/early-mistakes-that-make-a-brokerage-complaint-worse): How documentation and expectations shape a brokerage complaint before the merits.
- [What to Do When a Commercial Lease Default Notice Arrives](https://naultlaw.com/articles/what-to-do-when-a-commercial-lease-default-notice-arrives): Cure rights, termination risk, and guaranty exposure after a default notice.
- [Five Commercial Lease Terms Worth Slowing Down For](https://naultlaw.com/articles/five-commercial-lease-terms-worth-slowing-down-for): The provisions that control leverage later in a lease dispute.
- [What to Do First After a TREC Complaint Arrives](https://naultlaw.com/articles/what-to-do-first-after-a-trec-complaint-arrives): Organizing the record and risk before responding to a TREC complaint.
- [What the Tennessee Real Estate Commission Can and Cannot Do](https://naultlaw.com/articles/what-the-tennessee-real-estate-commission-can-and-cannot-do): Why a TREC complaint is not a lawsuit and how that changes strategy.
- [Owner Dispute Warning Signs Before the Business Stalls](https://naultlaw.com/articles/owner-dispute-warning-signs-before-the-business-stalls): Reading early warning signs of an owner dispute.
- [What Investigate and Advise Looks Like Before Suit](https://naultlaw.com/articles/what-investigate-and-advise-looks-like-before-suit): Pre-suit work to determine what matters and what the next move should accomplish.
